subject: general
question: As of September 2021, how many times has the Indian Men's Hockey team won a silver medal at the Summer Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Men's Hockey team won a silver medal at the Summer Olympic Games in Rome in 1960.**
 
• Pakistan won the gold medal, defeating India in the final and ending India's run of six successive gold medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manpreet Singh Pawar is the current captain of the Indian men's hockey team. (April 2022)
 
• He led the Indian field hockey team to the bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• The Olympic medals were won by the Indian men's hockey team at the Olympics.
